hash_semantics.wire_schema_sha256: exact wire_schema.json bytes using recorded serialization
hash_semantics.canonical: JSON sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8; not original file bytes

wire_serialization: UTF-8; ensure_ascii=false; indent=2; allow_nan=false; LF terminator
schema_dialect: Draft 7 (declared, or explicit generator default when absent)
numeric_scope: Every parsed JSON number must preserve its mathematical decimal value under wire serialization. Arbitrary-precision JSON integers remain integers; float overflow, underflow or lost decimal precision is refused. Equivalent numeric spellings such as 1 and 1.0 denote the same JSON Schema number.

transformations.equivalence_basis: Under standard Draft 7 validation, const equality implies JSON type string; intersecting with that type preserves the legal instance set. JSON numbers compare mathematically; booleans are distinct from numbers. No literal data or other constraint is changed.

scope: Only redundant const types; standard Draft 7 local JSON-pointer references; no nested resource IDs.
guarantee_limit: Each listed transformation has a local const-implies-type argument. Differential samples are regression evidence, not a general schema equivalence proof or evidence that a backend accepts this schema.
runtime_requirement: Preserve raw native JSON and validate original business schema before tools; no instance repair.
